# S14 — Recipe browse and metadata editing

Admin pages to list and view recipes and edit their larder metadata (R4).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:** web

**Not in this slice:** editing recipe content (done in git); ingredient review (separate slice).

## Why

The planner needs metadata (meal type, in rotation, kid favorite, servings, effort) that the files don't carry.

## Owner input

1. Metadata fields: meal type (dinner/breakfast/lunch/side/dessert), servings, in rotation (bool), kid favorite (bool), effort (quick/normal/project). Add or remove any?
2. Should a non-technical household member see recipe pages (read-only) from the Today view? (recommended: yes, with a "view recipe" link)

## Files

- `src/larder/web/recipes_views.py`, templates `recipes/list.html`, `recipes/view.html`, `recipes/meta_form.html`
- `tests/test_recipes_web.py`

## Failing tests

1. `test_list_filters_by_meal_type_and_rotation`
2. `test_view_renders_ingredients_and_directions_safely` (HTML-escaped Markdown)
3. `test_admin_can_edit_meta_member_cannot`
4. `test_meta_survives_reindex`

## Implement

1. Recipe list with filters; recipe view rendering Markdown. Note: stdlib has no Markdown renderer, so render the known subset (headings, lists, bold, paragraphs) with escaping, or ask the owner before adding a dependency.
2. Metadata form with CSRF; store in `recipe_meta`.
3. Bulk "mark in rotation" checkboxes on the list for fast setup.

## Check

- Web tests pass; after pairing, the owner can tag all imported recipes in a couple of minutes.

Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
